note: Fleets and commanders (v2, after step 10). Sea lanes join every coastal province to every other within `sea.lane` map units; a lane costs a point for each `sea.perPoint` units, and a fleet has `sea.points` a month (halved in winter storms). A fleet is built at a coastal city we hold, or at a vassal's (`fleet.cost` production); it carries one army from its port to another and lands it there: into an enemy army that is a battle (the landing fights at `fleet.landing` of its strength), into an enemy town a siege or a fall, as by land. Fleets meeting in a port fight at sea: odds by numbers, the loser's fleet sunk. Starting fleets by realm in `fleet.start`. Skellige raids: at war, its fleets carry its armies to the nearest enemy coast. Commanders: each great power's kings and marshals, by chapter (`from`), each with a skill: `power` (a share more strength in battle), `morale` (a head start in morale) or `siege` (a share more when storming). One commander leads an army; a commander whose army is beaten is wounded and out of the field for `wounded` months, then returns to court. A commander at court may be sent to any army of ours on our own land.
